$comment: Hook wiring for the quenching OKF validator. MERGE these blocks into the target repo's .claude/settings.json (do not overwrite the whole file). Copy cq + the quenching/ package directory + hooks-config.json into .claude/hooks/ alongside each other. Commands use ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}; if you distribute the plugin through the plugin channel instead, wire the same command with ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/assets/bin/cq in the plugin's hooks.json.

PostToolUse.$comment: OKF conformance on every /.knowledge/** edit: validates the touched file against the OKF core (parseable frontmatter + non-empty type on concept docs; index.md is a frontmatter-free listing; log.md is ## YYYY-MM-DD newest-first) and PROPOSES the fix via additionalContext. Exit 0 always (PostToolUse does not undo the edit). Set okfValidate.blockOnFail:true in hooks-config.json to escalate errors to decision:block.

Stop.$comment: End-of-turn full-bundle sweep: re-validates /.knowledge/ and PROPOSES residual gaps via additionalContext (exit 0). Dirty-gated by default (stopScan:'dirty'): runs only when a /.knowledge/** file was edited since the last completed scan, else exits on one stat. Honors stop_hook_active to avoid loops; deadlineMs aborts a scan mid-walk (marker kept for the next turn).

hooks.$comment_PreToolUse: OPT-IN HARD GATE. To BLOCK non-conformant writes before they land (writing an index.md with a concept type, or a concept doc with no type), set okfValidate.hardBlock:true in hooks-config.json AND uncomment the PreToolUse block below. It uses permissionDecision:'deny' (wins even under bypassPermissions). Left out of the default wiring so the plugin proposes rather than blocks.
